notes: urllib3 did not strip the Cookie header when following a cross-origin redirect. urllib3 does not set cookies itself, so this is only reachable when the caller sets a Cookie header by hand and allows redirects. The vast majority of urllib3 users - including everyone reaching it transitively through requests - are not affected.
reviewer_note: Classic transitive-dependency false positive: urllib3 is in every lockfile, this advisory applies to almost no one.
